value.originalTitle: ビビッドレッド・オペレーション

overview.value: La storia di Vividred Operation si ambienta in un mondo futuribile ove la scienza e la tecnica hanno migliorato di molto la vita delle persone grazie all'invenzione dell'"Expression Engine", il quale aveva risolto cinque anni prima una grave crisi energetica. Protagonista è l'allegra 14enne Akane Isshiki, che in quel tempo vive assieme al nonno e alla sorellina. Di fronte a una misteriosa ed incombente minaccia Akane si impegnerà a combattere per la difesa della Terra grazie a una tuta da battaglia che le dona straordinarie capacità. Ma non sarà sola poiché con lei ci saranno anche altre sue amiche.

tagline.value: みんなとだったら、世界だって救える

translations.title: Vividred Operation
translations.overview: On an artificial island, Akane Isshiki, an innocent 14-year-old girl, lives a simple but happy life with her level-headed little sister Momo and their genius inventor grandfather. On clear days just over the water, everyone on the island can see the revolutionary invention that solved all the world's energy problems, the Manifestation Engine. Thanks to the Manifestation Engine, the peaceful days that everyone had dreamed of had arrived. But suddenly, a mysterious enemy called the "Alone" appear out of nowhere aiming to attack the Manifestation Engine, jeopardizing their quiet way of life. Equipped with incredibly powerful Palette Suits designed by her grandfather, Akane and her friends must rise up together in this desperate situation. Their friendship is the only hope to save the world.

そう遠くない未来。夢のエネルギー炉「示現エンジン」の誕生によって、エネルギー問題は解決し平和な世界が訪れた。「示現エンジン」が建つ人工島「ブルーアイランド」の傍にある伊豆大島に発明家の祖父や妹と一緒に住む天真爛漫な少女・一色あかね。彼女は毎朝新聞配達をして家計を支えており、貧乏でありながらも家族と楽しい生活を送っていた。だが、示現エンジンを狙う謎の敵・アローンの出現によりそんな生活が一気に崩れだす。突如危機に陥った世界を救うため、あかねは祖父が発明したパレットスーツを身にまとい、友人と力を合わせてアローンに立ち向かう！
translations.tagline: みんなとだったら、世界だって救える
